title: Complete spell, creature, hazard, and magic-item projection
description:
Compile spells, creatures, hazards, and magic items into clause-complete
procedures, implemented against the A1 IR and the A2 shared primitives.

Cross-cutting root cause: the projectors for these four families were written
independently, so each re-parses recurring mechanics and each drops a different
subset. The half-damage-on-success omission appearing in all four is the
signature of the problem.
acceptance_criteria:
- Every printed deterministic hook in these families is represented and engine-mapped, or explicitly non-engine with a clause-level rationale.
- No generic metadata can make an incomplete record appear complete.
- Exact membership is reconciled by committed predicates, not by the named examples in the reviews.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
